basic_info.description: Quiet, Convenient, beautifully updated home in the desirable North Slope of Bernal Heights! This light-filled and airy property features updated kitchen, bath,  Double-pane vinyl windows and 100-amp electrical service, hardwood floors throughout  Spacious kitchen and a versatile living/dining room combo, Two large bedrooms offering comfort and style.The full basement provides parking for two cars and room to expand or customize. Enjoy the terraced backyard with a patio ready for your personal touch and gardening ideas!    Located just a short stroll to Bernal Park, Precita Park, and the vibrant shops and restaurants of Cortland Avenue. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to live in one of Bernal's most sought-after neighborhoods!
